en.title: About mcp.hk · mcp.hk
en.heading: About mcp.hk
en.description: mcp.hk is independent, open-source infrastructure for Hong Kong public data, extending mcp-open-data-hk with MCP, HTTP APIs and source-linked data workflows.

sections.heading: What is mcp.hk?
paragraphs: mcp.hk gives apps and AI assistants a shared, read-only interface to Hong Kong public data. Developers can discover datasets, inspect source resources and query supported records through MCP or HTTP. Public access is free and does not require an mcp.hk account or API key. Rate limits and provider availability apply.

sections.heading: Independent software, original sources
paragraphs: mcp.hk is not a Hong Kong Government service and is not endorsed by every data provider. It extends the open-source mcp-open-data-hk project. Government data and independent packs such as Plate.hk and SeeHouse retain their own identity, attribution and terms. The MIT licence covers the software, not all underlying data.

sections.heading: Corrections and contributions
paragraphs: Report a broken source, unclear field or software issue in the public repository. Include the dataset or resource identifier and a reproducible example. Do not post credentials, private queries or personal information. Source providers remain the authority for the original records.
If you need a private contact route, request one before sharing personal information in a public issue.

zh-Hant.title: 關於 mcp.hk · mcp.hk
zh-Hant.heading: 關於 mcp.hk
zh-Hant.description: mcp.hk 是獨立的香港公共數據開源基建，在 mcp-open-data-hk 的基礎上提供 MCP、HTTP API 及附有來源連結的數據查詢。

sections.heading: mcp.hk 是甚麼？
paragraphs: mcp.hk 為應用程式及 AI 助手提供統一、唯讀的香港公共數據介面。開發者可透過 MCP 或 HTTP 搜尋數據集、查看來源檔案及查詢支援的記錄。公共存取免費，毋須 mcp.hk 帳戶或 API 密鑰，惟設有請求限制，亦受來源的可用情況影響。

sections.heading: 獨立軟件，保留原始來源
paragraphs: mcp.hk 並非香港政府服務，亦不代表已獲所有數據供應者認可。本項目在開源 mcp-open-data-hk 的基礎上擴充。政府數據及 Plate.hk、SeeHouse 等獨立數據包各有其來源、標示及使用條款。MIT 授權只涵蓋軟件，並非所有原始數據。

sections.heading: 更正及參與開發
paragraphs: 如發現來源無法讀取、欄位意思不清或軟件問題，可於公開儲存庫回報。請提供數據集或來源識別碼及可重現的範例，切勿發布憑證、私人查詢或個人資料。原始記錄應以供應者發布的內容為準。
如須私人聯絡途徑，請先提出要求，切勿在公開議題發布個人資料。

en.title: How to use a Hong Kong open data API · mcp.hk
en.heading: How to use a Hong Kong open data API
en.description: Discover a dataset, inspect its source and read supported records through mcp.hk. Keep catalogue metadata, query access and source reliability distinct.

sections.heading: 1. Make your first request
paragraphs: No account or key is needed. This request returns one district-wide population record in data, its reference year in data.referencePeriod, and original source links in provenance. A recent source check does not change the statistical reference year.

sections.heading: 2. From catalogue to weather records
paragraphs: Commands checked on 25 October 2026. Discover the dataset, list its resources, inspect fields, then read a weather bulletin. This RSS source returns one bulletin, rather than one row per station. Its description retains source HTML: display it as text, never execute it.
sections.code:
curl -fsS 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/catalogue/datasets?q=current%20weather&access=sources&limit=5'
curl -fsS 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/resources?datasetId=hk-hko-rss-current-weather-report&limit=10'
curl -fsS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/resources/770e68f0676dcbf8e65e2b4e1c6f6e60/schema'
curl -fsS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"fields":["item.title","item.pubDate","item.description","item.link"],"limit":5}' 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/resources/770e68f0676dcbf8e65e2b4e1c6f6e60/query'

sections.heading: 3. Recognize success and keep evidence
paragraphs: Captured response excerpt, 25 October 2026, not live weather: item.title was Bulletin updated at 10:02 HKT 25/10/2026; item.pubDate was Sun, 25 Oct 2026 02:02:00 GMT; item.description included an Observatory temperature of 27 degrees Celsius. Preserve original values, source links and warnings. provenance.publicationDate dates the resource, not the weather observation.

sections.heading: 4. When a source changes
paragraphs: For later pages pass meta.version and meta.nextOffset. On RESOURCE_VERSION_CHANGED restart at the first page. SCHEMA_DRIFT means changed fields, not zero records; explicitly choose another listed source or visit the publisher. On 429 wait for Retry-After; do not loop through sources.

zh-Hant.title: 如何使用香港開放數據 API · mcp.hk
zh-Hant.heading: 如何使用香港開放數據 API
zh-Hant.description: 透過 mcp.hk 搜尋數據集、檢查來源及讀取支援的記錄，並分清目錄資料、查詢能力及來源可靠程度。

sections.heading: 1. 先取得地區資料
paragraphs: 毋須帳戶或密鑰。此請求在 data 回傳一個地區的全區人口紀錄，data.referencePeriod 是統計年份，provenance 提供原始來源連結。最近檢查來源不會改變統計參考年份。

sections.heading: 2. 從目錄到天氣紀錄
paragraphs: 以下指令於 2026 年 10 月 25 日核對。依次尋找天氣數據集、來源、欄位及一項天氣報告。這是 RSS 報告，並非每站一列的數據表；description 保留來源 HTML，應以文字顯示，切勿直接執行。
sections.code:
curl -fsS 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/catalogue/datasets?q=current%20weather&access=sources&limit=5'
curl -fsS 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/resources?datasetId=hk-hko-rss-current-weather-report&limit=10'
curl -fsS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/resources/770e68f0676dcbf8e65e2b4e1c6f6e60/schema'
curl -fsS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"fields":["item.title","item.pubDate","item.description","item.link"],"limit":5}' 'https://mcp.hk/api/v1/resources/770e68f0676dcbf8e65e2b4e1c6f6e60/query'

sections.heading: 3. 辨認成功及保留來源
paragraphs: 以下為 2026 年 10 月 25 日擷取的回應節錄，並非即時天氣：item.title 為 Bulletin updated at 10:02 HKT 25/10/2026；item.pubDate 為 Sun, 25 Oct 2026 02:02:00 GMT；item.description 包括香港天文台氣溫 27 degrees Celsius。請保留原始值、來源連結及警告。provenance.publicationDate 是來源發布日期，不是天氣觀測時間。

sections.heading: 4. 版本或來源有變時
paragraphs: 後續分頁須傳回 meta.version 及 meta.nextOffset。收到 RESOURCE_VERSION_CHANGED 時，重新從第一頁開始。SCHEMA_DRIFT 代表欄位變更，並非沒有紀錄；可明確改選 RSS 來源或查看原始來源。429 請按 Retry-After 等候，切勿循環重試。

en.title: Connect an AI assistant to Hong Kong data with MCP · mcp.hk
en.heading: Connect an AI assistant to Hong Kong data with MCP
en.description: Use the mcp.hk Streamable HTTP endpoint to discover Hong Kong datasets and request source-linked records from an MCP client.

sections.heading: Use the public endpoint
paragraphs: The remote MCP endpoint is https://mcp.hk/mcp. Public data access is read-only and requires no mcp.hk API key. Set a startup timeout of 120 seconds where supported because the data container may need to start. Your AI client or model provider may have its own charges.

sections.heading: Ask for discovery, records and citations
paragraphs: Try: “Find Hong Kong public holiday data, inspect the available sources and show the supported records with original source links.” Ask the assistant to report access limitations, source dates and warnings. Do not infer that all catalogue resources are queryable.

sections.heading: Use HTTP when your client does not support MCP
paragraphs: The same service exposes an HTTP API and OpenAPI description. Use the connection page and API reference for current request contracts. Never paste operator credentials into an AI connection; public reads do not need them.

sections.heading: Recognize a successful connection
paragraphs: Finish only after the client lists hk_district_statistics and returns the central-western population record, reference year and original source. Copying settings or checking HTTP health does not establish a client connection. Choose Codex, Claude Code or Cursor on Connect AI; other apps need custom remote Streamable HTTP MCP support.

zh-Hant.title: 透過 MCP 讓 AI 助手讀取香港數據 · mcp.hk
zh-Hant.heading: 透過 MCP 讓 AI 助手讀取香港數據
zh-Hant.description: 使用 mcp.hk 的 Streamable HTTP 端點，讓 MCP 客戶端搜尋香港數據集及讀取附有來源連結的記錄。

sections.heading: 使用公共端點
paragraphs: 遠端 MCP 端點是 https://mcp.hk/mcp。公共數據存取為唯讀，毋須 mcp.hk API 密鑰。如客戶端支援，可將啟動逾時設為 120 秒，因為數據容器可能需要啟動。AI 客戶端或模型供應者可能另有收費。

sections.heading: 要求搜尋、讀取記錄及提供來源
paragraphs: 可試問：「找出香港公眾假期數據，檢查可用來源，再列出支援的記錄及原始來源連結。」請 AI 說明存取限制、來源日期及警告，切勿假設目錄中的所有來源都能查詢。

sections.heading: 客戶端不支援 MCP 時可使用 HTTP
paragraphs: 同一服務亦提供 HTTP API 及 OpenAPI 描述。最新請求規格可參閱連接頁及 API 文件。切勿將營運憑證貼入 AI 連接設定；公共讀取並不需要這些憑證。

sections.heading: 辨認連接成功
paragraphs: 客戶端須列出 hk_district_statistics，並實際回傳 central-western 的人口、統計年份及來源，才算完成。網站複製成功或 HTTP 健康檢查不等於 AI 已連接。請在連接頁選擇 Codex、Claude Code 或 Cursor；其他客戶端須支援自訂遠端 Streamable HTTP MCP。
links: 客戶端設定及排解問題

en.title: How to cite Hong Kong data and check freshness · mcp.hk
en.heading: How to cite Hong Kong data and check freshness
en.description: Use original provider citations, inspect timestamps and reference periods, and distinguish catalogue coverage from validated and semantically qualified records.

sections.heading: Cite the original provider
paragraphs: mcp.hk is an access layer. Cite original provider URLs and attribution from the response provenance, and add the mcp.hk query or guide as the access method when useful. DATA.GOV.HK and CSDI are discovery portals; the dataset publisher is the authority for the underlying records.

sections.heading: Three different clocks
paragraphs: A catalogue sync time describes metadata discovery. A retrieval or validation time describes a source read or check. The observation time or reference period describes when the underlying event or statistic applies. A recent read does not turn an old statistic into current data. Inspect stale flags, warnings and the original source before making a time-sensitive claim.

sections.heading: Interpret each data pack within its limits
paragraphs: Restaurant licence records are not reviews or a guarantee that a venue is currently open. District population is a district statistic, not population within a restaurant search radius. Plate.hk provides historical auction results, not current ownership, availability or valuations. SeeHouse listing asking prices and their changes are not completed transactions. Transport checks apply to the requested source, route and stop; a timetable is not a live arrival prediction.

sections.heading: Coverage and failure states
paragraphs: A catalogue entry may be metadata-only. Sources can be unsupported, restricted, unavailable, require selection, exceed capacity or have schema drift. Preserve those states in applications and AI answers. A successful raw read still needs semantic checks for units, field meaning and suitability.

sections.heading: A citation and the next action
paragraphs: Citation example (captured 25 October 2026): “Hong Kong Observatory, Current Weather Report, 25 October 2026 10:02 HKT, accessed through mcp.hk.” The bulletin date and service-read time are separate. An archive does not verify current registration. Preview available: read a bounded page. Settings needed: choose inputs first. Temporarily unavailable: follow retry guidance. Source link only: visit the publisher.

zh-Hant.title: 如何引用香港數據及檢查時效 · mcp.hk
zh-Hant.heading: 如何引用香港數據及檢查時效
zh-Hant.description: 引用原始供應者、檢查時間及參考期，並分清目錄收錄、來源驗證與數據含義的確認。

sections.heading: 引用原始供應者
paragraphs: mcp.hk 是存取介面。引用回應來源資料中的原始供應者網址及標示；如有需要，可補充 mcp.hk 查詢或指南作為存取方法。DATA.GOV.HK 及 CSDI 是數據發現入口，原始記錄仍應以發布者為準。

sections.heading: 分清三種時間
paragraphs: 目錄同步時間表示何時取得目錄資料；擷取或驗證時間表示何時讀取或檢查來源；觀測時間或統計參考期則表示事件或統計適用的時段。最近讀取的舊統計，不會因此變成最新數據。作出具時效性的判斷前，應檢查 stale 標記、警告及原始來源。

sections.heading: 按數據包的限制解讀
paragraphs: 食肆牌照記錄不是食評，亦不保證店舖現正營業。地區人口屬全區統計，不是食肆搜尋半徑內的人口。Plate.hk 提供過往拍賣結果，並非現時擁有權、出售狀態或估值。SeeHouse 的放盤叫價及變動不是成交紀錄。交通檢查只適用於所查詢的來源、路綫及車站；時間表不等於即時到站預測。

sections.heading: 覆蓋範圍及失敗狀態
paragraphs: 目錄項目可能只有描述資料。來源可能尚未支援、受存取限制、暫時不可用、須先選擇設定、超出容量，或出現結構變更。應用程式及 AI 回答必須保留這些狀態。即使成功讀取原始回應，仍須檢查單位、欄位意思及是否適合用途。

sections.heading: 引用及下一步
paragraphs: 引用例子（2026 年 10 月 25 日擷取）：「香港天文台，本港天氣報告，2026 年 10 月 25 日 10:02 HKT，透過 mcp.hk 讀取。」報告日期與服務讀取日期分開；歷史存檔不能證明目前註冊狀態。可預覽：讀取有界紀錄；須設定：先選參數；暫時不可用：按建議時間再試；只提供來源連結：前往提供者。

en.title: Racing source status · mcp.hk
en.heading: Racing source status
en.description: Racing results, profiles and prospective observations are awaiting source permission. No racing dataset is published.

sections.heading: Coverage has not been qualified
paragraphs: No complete meeting, season or historical range has been accepted. Declared runners, results, sectionals, dividends, profiles, trials, comments, rankings, track conditions and jackpots remain unavailable. Racing result tables overlap; they do not establish separate coverage.

sections.heading: Prospective observations
paragraphs: Odds, pool investments and racing changes have no observation start or measured cadence. No historical odds are inferred. Collection and scheduling remain disabled.

sections.heading: Source and reuse
paragraphs: HKJC collection, retained history, public API, MCP, browser links and downloads require separate qualification. Status checked 25 October 2026. No race search or download is offered while these modes are held.

sections.heading: For an AI client
paragraphs: hk_racing_status returns the same source gate. Racing data tools are not advertised as available. No source request is made by a status read.

zh-Hant.title: 賽馬來源狀態 · mcp.hk
zh-Hant.heading: 賽馬來源狀態
zh-Hant.description: 賽果、參賽者資料及前瞻觀測仍待來源授權。目前未有發布賽馬資料集。

sections.heading: 覆蓋範圍尚未核實
paragraphs: 尚未接納完整賽事日、馬季或歷史範圍。出賽名單、賽果、分段時間、派彩、馬匹資料、試閘、沿途走勢、騎師及練馬師排名、場地狀況和多寶仍未提供。重疊的賽果表不代表不同覆蓋範圍。

sections.heading: 前瞻觀測
paragraphs: 賠率、彩池投注額及賽事改動尚未開始觀測，也沒有實測更新頻率。我們不推算歷史賠率。收集及排程仍然停用。

sections.heading: 來源及使用權限
paragraphs: HKJC 自動收集、歷史保留、公開 API、MCP、瀏覽器連結及下載須分別核實。狀態核查日期：2026 年 10 月 25 日。權限未確認前不提供賽事搜尋或下載。

sections.heading: 供 AI 客戶端使用
paragraphs: hk_racing_status 回傳相同的來源限制。賽馬資料工具未列作可用。讀取狀態不會向來源發出請求。

en: mcp.hk is an independent, open-source Hong Kong public data service for apps and AI. It provides a read-only MCP server and HTTP API with original source links.
Is mcp.hk free, and do I need an API key?
Public read-only access is free and needs no mcp.hk account or API key. Request limits and source availability apply. Your AI client or model provider may charge separately.
How do I connect an AI assistant?
Use https://mcp.hk/mcp as the Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Open the Connect page for client settings. Allow a 120-second startup timeout where supported.
Can I query every Hong Kong government dataset?
No. Catalogue discovery, supported record queries and semantic verification are different. Check each source’s format, access state, warnings and original terms.
How should I cite data returned by mcp.hk?

Cite the original provider URLs and attribution from response provenance. Keep source dates, reference periods, warnings and stale flags. mcp.hk is the access method; it is not the publisher of every underlying dataset.
zh-Hant: mcp.hk 是獨立的香港公共數據開源服務，供應用程式及 AI 使用，提供唯讀 MCP 伺服器及 HTTP API，並保留原始來源連結。
mcp.hk 是否免費？需要 API 密鑰嗎？
公共唯讀存取免費，毋須 mcp.hk 帳戶或 API 密鑰，但設有請求限制，亦受來源可用情況影響。AI 客戶端或模型供應者可能另行收費。
如何連接 AI 助手？
使用 https://mcp.hk/mcp 作為 Streamable HTTP MCP 端點。連接頁提供客戶端設定；如支援，可將啟動逾時設為 120 秒。
是否可以查詢所有香港政府數據集？
不可以。目錄搜尋、支援的記錄查詢及數據含義驗證是不同層次。請逐一檢查來源的格式、存取狀態、警告及原始條款。
應如何引用 mcp.hk 回傳的數據？
請引用回應來源資料中的原始供應者網址及標示，並保留來源日期、參考期、警告及 stale 標記。mcp.hk 是存取方法，並非每個原始數據集的發布者。
